currentRoundInspection.scope: Useful pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only; no bespoke survey or redistributed photography.

pictures.observed: Aerial from sea: long raised nave with repeated round-headed clerestory,lower red-tiled aisles,polygonal eastern apse,western octagonal baptistery and separate pale tower with steep stone spire; open archaeological court and northern palace ranges. Surrounding town/seawall excluded.
Weathered square tower,paired round belfry arches with central columns,thin cornices and steep stone spire/cross. Lower buildings have pale plaster,red tile and round windows.

Atrium round arcades with central columns/capitals and barrel soffits. Western church gable has three round-headed windows above tiled portico and colored mosaic bands. Represent bands/selected motifs; exact religious figures and tesserae excluded.
